entries.source: Stadtarchiv Rothenburg ob der Tauber, 12_b Repertorium Urkunden, Nr. 1756
entries.german: Markgraf Casimir vegleicht Zaisolph von Rosenberg mit Rotenburg bezüglich des im Bauernaufruhr erlittenen Schadens. – Ausf. Perg. Siegel anhängend, erhalten.
entries.english: Margrave Casimir settles the dispute between Zaisolph von Rosenberg and Rothenburg concerning damages suffered during the Peasants’ War. Original, parchment; seal attached and preserved.

facts.content: settled with Rothenburg over damages suffered during the Peasants’ War.
